items.title: Pay outstanding balance from annual statement
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Private company invoice, so the ordinary civil-law rule (§187(1) BGB, period starting from an event) applies: the statement date 20 Nov 2026 is the triggering event and is not counted itself; counting begins the next day (21 Nov 2026). 14 days later: 21-30 Nov = 10 days, 1-4 Dec = 4 more days, total 14 days, landing on 4 Dec 2026. 4 Dec 2026 is a Friday (24 Nov 2026 is the given Tuesday; counting forward: 24 Tue,25 Wed,26 Thu,27 Fri,28 Sat,29 Sun,30 Mon,1 Tue,2 Wed,3 Thu,4 Fri), not a weekend and no NRW public holiday falls on that day, so no extension under §193 BGB is needed.

items.title: New higher monthly instalment takes effect
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter states the new instalment amount applies 'from December' without giving the exact day of the month on which instalments are collected, so the earliest the change can take effect is the first day of December 2026; the precise collection date within December is not stated.
